crossRefs.note: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of…
For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God…
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…
The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind…
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
translations.bsb: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
translations.kjv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
translations.asv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.
